name: Compare
author: AAidalol
description: The current oldest standing level on the AALL, being the 3rd level Aida ever created, initially created to compare how fast she could click with one mouse compared to the other in the editor, hence the name, 'Compare'. Never intended to be verified, but verified anyways back in 2025 and determined to be listworthy for the new AALL in August 2026. Hardest part is 34-40.
